notes.title: Hotfix 1.004
notes.content:
-Bug that prevents reaching the end of the game fixed.
-Puzzle difficulty lowered.

notes.title: Patch 1.003
notes.content: -Added visual cues throughout the game so the players can better know what to do.

notes.title: Patch 1.002
notes.content:
-Mid game puzzle and map difficulty adjusted.
-Translation change.
-Bug fix.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.001
notes.content:
-Fixed some bugs on the latter part of the game.
-Minor change to Korean translation.
-Small adjustment to one of the puzzles.

notes.title: Letters of Bernard Thorne is Now Playable
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=hHO9OsDmyko;full][/previewyoutube]
Experience the horrors of Bernard's past and most importantly, go up the attic.

*The demo version of the game has been removed from Steam store because it no longer accurately represents the current state of the full game.

notes.title: [Letters of Bernard Thorne] Demo Launched
notes.content:
The demo for Letters of Bernard Thorne is available on its Steam store page.
It focuses on showcasing basic gameplay mechanics and its tone as a psychological horror game.
Please share your feedback in the Steam community hub or KLL's SNS channels.
